thread:
alex_m: Heads-up — planning a gradual canary for service-model v3.2.0 today at 17:30 PT. Plan: 2% -> 10% -> 25% (30m pauses). Need deploy owner, smoke, rollback plan. Target cohorts: US-west small, EU-central small. @maria-chen can you take deploy lead? :clipboard:

maria-chen: I can take deploy owner. Timeline works for me. I'll be online from 17:15. What's the smoke checklist and rollback command?

jamie: I'll run smoke. Smoke checklist below:
- health endpoint /health
- sample inference (prompt list)
- latency & error-rate quick dashboard check
Quick commands:
```curl -sS https://svc.example/health```
```python tests/smoke/run_sample_inference.py --model v3.2.0```

derek: Rollback: immediate traffic shift to v3.1.9 alias + scale-down v3.2 pods. Command:
```infractl traffic shift --to=stable --service=model-svc --percent=100```
Also keep rollback playbook open: /playbooks/rollbacks/model-service.md

sophia_r: Cohort selection confirmed: US-west-2: 0.5% of traffic -> 1.5% (part of 2%). EU-central: 0.5% -> then include fragment to reach 2%. We should avoid APAC during initial ramp. Can we add a latency guardrail: p95 < 200ms or auto-hold? :warning:

alex_m: Good call. We'll enable auto-hold on policy if p95 > 200ms for 5m. Ops: enable `gradual_rollout_policy:v3` with thresholds. Can someone verify infra has enough headroom for cache warming? @jamie?

jamie: infra looks fine. KV cache warming can be prepopulated with top-100 prompts using `scripts/cache_warmup.py --model v3.2.0 --prompts top100.txt`. I'll run that at 17:00 PT.

deploy-bot: Deployment pipeline triggered by maria-chen on branch release/v3.2.0. Build 4827 queued. CI smoke tests required before traffic shift.

maria-chen: CI quick-smoke passed locally, pushing build now. I'll post back at each ramp step. @derek please have rollback hook ready for immediate exec.

derek: rollback hook staged and tested on staging. I have a one-liner ready:
```./ops/rollbacks/shift_to_stable.sh model-svc``` — I'll be watching channel.

ops-bot: Reminder — on-call SRE (sophia_r) notified for 17:30 PT window. Paging plan: slack->sms if threshold hit.

alex_m: Perfect. Final checklist: deploy owner (maria-chen), smoke (jamie), rollback (derek), SRE (sophia_r). Ramp schedule: 17:30 start -> 2% (5m monitor) -> 10% (30m monitor) -> 25% (60m monitor). If any guardrail trips, auto-hold + manual triage. I'll thread status updates here.

maria-chen: On it. Posting status updates: BUILD STARTED -> BUILD PASSED -> ROLLING -> 2% OK -> 10% HOLD if needed. :rocket:

jamie: I'll post smoke results as attachments. TL;DR: sample inference 10/10, p95=120ms, error rate 0.0%.

derek: standing by for immediate rollback. ping me with `ROLLBACK NOW` if needed.

sophia_r: I'll watch alerts and escalate. If we hit p95>200ms for 5m or error_rate>1% we'll hold.
